name: Omakase! Trouble Angel
original_name: おまかせ！とらぶる天使（エンジェル）
source:
Kazuma has been living in an orphanage. He doesn't know why he came there and where his parents are. But he is not all alone. He lives with two girls, Haruna and Akiu, there. All of them don't know how they came and if they are relatives or not. The only fact they know is they live like a real family. However, Haruna grew up and left the orphanage and Akiu also left the orphanage. They kept in touch for a while but gradually they lost in touch with one another. Several years have passed... The story starts just when Kazuma is about to leave the orphanage.

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
一马一直生活在孤儿院，不知道自己为何来到这里，也不知道父母身在何处。但他并不孤单，春菜与秋优两名少女和他住在一起。三人都不知道自己如何来到孤儿院，也不知道彼此是否有血缘关系，唯一确定的是，他们像真正的家人一样生活。然而，春菜长大后离开孤儿院，秋优后来也离开了。三人一度保持联系，却渐渐失去彼此的消息。数年过去……故事开始时，一马也即将离开孤儿院。

[摘自Himeya Shop]
